summary: This informational document proposes the "altc" attribute for SDP, which lets one offer carry multiple IP addresses of different address families, such as IPv4 and IPv6. It avoids the backward-compatibility problems of ANAT. It is meant for cases where connectivity checks are not needed; where they are, ICE applies.

eli5.summary: This lets one call invitation list both old-style and new-style addresses, so the other side can use whichever works.

questions: offering ipv4 and ipv6 addresses in one sdp
